lane: جنك جَنْكٌ [and جُنْكٌ] A certain [musical] instrument, which is beaten like the عُود [or lute; namely, the Persian harp; two specimens of which are figured in Note 26 to Chap. iii. of my translation of the “Thousand and One Nights”]; mentioned by El-Khafájee in the Shifá el-Ghaleel; and often spoken of: it is an arabicized word; (MF, TA;) from the Persian چَنْگ: and applied [also] to the دفّ, [دُفّ or دَفّ, i. e., tambourine,] with which one plays. (TA.) جنكى جَنْكِىٌّ [and جُنْكِىٌّ] A player on the جنك above mentioned. (TA.)
